**Verdict: ready** (for the record; the PR merged before this review landed)

Built verification on Windows, in a worktree at this head, debug profile. I did not write this change. This adds build evidence to the collaborator review; no label or state change.

## Local results at `95ab41152`

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib chamfer`: 5 passed, 0 failed - includes `a_wall_farther_than_the_width_refuses_by_name` with its two new asserts (contains `would ride into the material under it;`, contains no `part`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test chamfer_modelled_edge --test edge_break_gate`: 5 + 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion`: clean.
- `git grep "ride into the part"` over `crates/`: the only hit was the message line itself; no other test, doc or recorded refusal asserts the old text. The body's grep claim holds.

## Checked from the diff

- Word-only change in one refusal string plus its doc comment; no condition, no API, no geometry changed. `GenError::At` still carries the spot.
